results.query: We clean commercial office buildings.

We are a commercial cleaning company. We provide janitorial and custodial services for office buildings: daily cleaning, restroom sanitation, trash removal, floor care, carpet cleaning and window washing.
We provide nurses and medical staffing.
We are a healthcare staffing firm. We place registered nurses, licensed practical nurses, nursing assistants and other clinical staff in hospitals, clinics and medical facilities.
We maintain HVAC systems.

We are a mechanical contractor. We maintain, repair and replace HVAC systems: heating, ventilation and air conditioning equipment, chillers, boilers, air handlers, rooftop units and building controls.
We provide security guards.
We are a security services company. We provide armed and unarmed security guards and officers for facility access control, patrols, posts and visitor screening.
We erect steel buildings and install metal roofing.
We are a construction contractor. We erect pre-engineered steel buildings and install and replace metal roofing systems, including standing seam roofs, wall panels and structural steel framing.
We do landscaping and grounds maintenance.
We are a landscaping company. We provide grounds maintenance for federal facilities: mowing, trimming, irrigation repair, tree care, planting, mulching and snow removal.
We do asphalt paving and site work.
We are a paving and site work contractor. We mill and pave asphalt, repair parking lots and roads, pour concrete curbs and sidewalks, stripe pavement and do grading and drainage.
We supply industrial and defense replacement parts.

We are a supplier of industrial and defense replacement parts. We source and deliver spare parts, components and assemblies for military equipment, vehicles, aircraft and industrial machinery, identified by NSN and part number.
We supply fasteners like bolts, screws and nuts.
We are a fastener distributor. We supply bolts, screws, nuts, washers, rivets, pins, studs and other fastening hardware to military and industrial specifications, identified by NSN and part number.
We supply electrical and electronic components.
We are a distributor of electrical and electronic components: connectors, relays, switches, resistors, capacitors, circuit cards, wire and cable assemblies, sold by NSN and manufacturer part number.
We supply industrial valves.
We are a valve supplier. We provide gate, globe, ball, check, butterfly, relief and control valves and valve parts for industrial, marine and military systems.
We supply aircraft parts and components.

We are an aerospace parts supplier. We provide airframe structural components, landing gear parts, aircraft hydraulic and fuel system components and other aircraft spares, identified by NSN and part number.
We supply medical, dental and laboratory supplies.

We are a medical supply distributor. We provide medical, surgical, dental and laboratory supplies and consumables such as gloves, syringes, dressings, reagents and lab equipment to hospitals and clinics.
We sell computer hardware and IT equipment.
We are an IT hardware reseller. We sell laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, networking equipment, storage and peripherals, including installation and warranty support.
